call_LlavaNextProcessor: call LlavaNextProcessor to process images and text together, returning input_ids, attention_mask, and pixel_values
get_number_of_image_features: get the number of tokens an image maps to based on its original height and width and the processor patch size
get_num_multimodal_tokens: get the number of multimodal tokens for a batch of image sizes formatted as list of height-width pairs
get_unpadded_image_features: get the number of unpadded features and newline features for an image given its dimensions and scale factors
configure_LlavaNextProcessorKwargs: configure LlavaNextProcessorKwargs with text padding, return_mm_token_type_ids, and image padding options
